title: The Day of Pentecost Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Day of Pentecost Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Pentecost Bible crossword: the rushing mighty wind, the cloven tongues of fire, and three thousand souls added. Free KJV puzzles on iPhone and iPad.
prose: They are all with one accord in one place when a sound comes from heaven like a rushing mighty wind and fills the house. Cloven tongues like as of fire sit on each of them, and they begin to speak in languages they never learned. The Day of Pentecost makes a grid of Acts 2.
The crowd's reaction is in the puzzle too — the list of nations, the accusation about new wine, and Peter's answer that it is but the third hour of the day. The closing verse is the filling itself.

clues.text: The sound from heaven was as of a rushing mighty one
Cloven tongues sat upon them like as of this
They began to speak with other ones
Apostle who stood up with the eleven and preached

verseText: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
